Journalist Claims Mossad Planned Attack on Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir

A Brazilian journalist has claimed that the Israeli intelligence agency Mossad planned to assassinate Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir. The alleged plot was reportedly intended to take place in Switzerland during Munir's talks in Geneva. This claim has generated significant discussion and concern.
